sharesSettings.title: File sharing
sharesSettings.subtitle: Manage temporary public download links for workspace files.
sharesSettings.needToken: Sign in to the gateway to manage file shares.
sharesSettings.emptyState: No shares yet. Create one from the file tree or via the API.
sharesSettings.createHint: Pick a workspace file or directory to generate a shareable link.
sharesSettings.pickerHintNone: Click a file or directory, then confirm
sharesSettings.shareConfirmHint: Anyone who can reach the generated link may download this file until the link expires or reaches its download limit.
sharesSettings.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard. Select the link and copy manually.
sharesSettings.revokeConfirmBody: This link will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
sharesSettings.cleanExpiredConfirmBody: This will revoke all expired and already-revoked shares permanently.
sharesSettings.reachLocalHint: Start the tunnel in Remote Access settings to make shares publicly accessible.
sharesSettings.policyHint: Limits and defaults for temporary file and site shares.
sharesSettings.policyFileSectionHint: Defaults and resource limits for downloadable files and browsable folders.
sharesSettings.policyDefaultTtlHint: Default TTL for new shares (1–168 hours).
sharesSettings.policyMaxTtlHint: Upper bound when creating or extending shares (1–30 days).
sharesSettings.policyMaxActiveSitesHint: Concurrent non-expired site shares allowed for HTML/site publishing (1–1,000).
sharesSettings.policyMaxFileSizeHint: Per-file limit for share creation (1 MB–10 GB).
sharesSettings.policyDirectoryMaxFolderSizeHint: Total size scanned for one folder share (1 MB–10 GB).
sharesSettings.policyDirectoryMaxFileCountHint: Files and directories scanned for one folder share (1–100,000).
sharesSettings.policyInlinePreviewMimesHint: MIME types allowed for ?inline=1 browser preview.
sharesSettings.policyMimePlaceholder: MIME type and press Enter (e.g. image/png)
sharesSettings.policySiteSectionHint: Independent expiry and publishing limits for static sites and local development servers.
sharesSettings.policySiteDefaultTtlHint: Default TTL for new site shares (1–168 hours).
sharesSettings.policySiteMaxTtlHint: Upper bound when creating or extending site shares (1–30 days).
sharesSettings.policySiteMaxRootDirSizeHint: Total size scanned for one static site (1 MB–10 GB).
sharesSettings.policySiteMaxFileCountHint: Files scanned when publishing one static site (1–100,000).
sharesSettings.policyRestartHint: Policy changes require a gateway restart.
